Needs changes before merge. The safety review is incomplete.

The source review found these strengths:

- The rows and the lap use the same cap points.
- The change keeps the crossing check intact.
- I checked every changed CL and NC golden line. The added moves follow the expected stadium boundary.
- The catalog cache contains the same lap at both levels.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slots.rs:165`: Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record the reached lanes and their results in the PR body. The current body states that these lanes did not run. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under **Heavy lanes at review**, requires them before the PR becomes ready. A motion change reaches the app heavy lanes.

Local validation:

- The head trial-merges cleanly with upstream main `aa4c785dbd53715f1d811524dc99c688b9380cba`.
- I attempted `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` locally. The corrected plan selected the PR's 26 changed files. It produced no valid gate result.
- I interrupted early build attempts too soon. Child builds retained Cargo locks. I invalidated those gate runs with a local review commit. This interruption was a reviewer error.
- I attempted `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test slot_round_ends`. It waited for the build lock and did not complete within the review time limit.
- The clippy attempt has no passing result. The quick gate, pinning tests, and clippy still need a complete local run.

The blocked commands reported:

```text
Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory
```

Mutations:

- Disable the wall lap: the test attempt timed out after 60 seconds at the Cargo lock. No red/green result.
- Remove the row-end splits: the test attempt timed out after 60 seconds at the Cargo lock. No red/green result.
- I restored both source files byte for byte. These attempts do not validate the mutations.

Extra suites run: none completed. The changed goldens require their reader suites. The quick plan included the app suites and the CL/post fixture readers. Their execution remains incomplete. No importer source or STEP fixture changed, so the extra kernel import checks do not apply.

Heavy lanes: not run. Light lane: not run. No UI code changed.

The source and golden checks do not establish a clean safety verdict. The missing heavy-lane evidence is a merge blocker. The local build interruption does not establish a product defect.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The missing heavy-lane evidence is now in the PR body.

- Heavy gate: all 235 steps complete; exit 0. The motion lane completes 37 steps. The app lane completes 197 steps. Six known-fail tests reproduce their expected failures for #1950 and #2849. The body names each test. No unexpected failure occurs.
- Quick gate: 731 of 732 steps pass. One test exceeds its debug time limit. The isolated failed-step retry passes both tests with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=1`.
- The CL and post fixture readers pass. The changed app and motion suites pass. Clippy passes for both touched crates.
- Disable the wall lap: all three `slot_round_ends` pins fail. Restore it: all three pass.
- Remove the row-end splits: `wide_slot_with_rows_off_the_tips_cuts_its_round_ends` fails its crossing assertion. Restore them: all three pins pass.

The source restores byte for byte. The worktree is clean. The head remains `35020f6cc294c3b6266be720b3c9d2b178c970f9`. This request needs validation evidence only; no source commit is needed.

Please re-review this head and the completed evidence.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 35020f6cc294c3b6266be720b3c9d2b178c970f9 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The later “Addressed” comment permits this review of the same head.
The earlier request for heavy-lane evidence is met. The PR body now records the completed run on this head.

The rows and the lap share their cap points. The lap closes at the last row end and keeps the selected direction.
The crossing check stays intact. The full-width slot keeps its existing path.
I checked every changed line in the CL and NC goldens and the catalog files.
The added moves follow the stadium boundary. The dialect centres, block numbers, inch values, and catalog levels agree.
The catalog stamp and first-move changes match the documented regeneration.

Local validation used a clean trial merge with upstream main `998c918bb04177c45a00396337b095e468acf4b8`.
I ran each command in the foreground and waited for completion. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 763 steps pass; zero failed; 65.3 minutes |
| CL reader | 3 tests pass |
| Post suites | 590 tests pass |
| Motion suites | 1,106 tests pass |
| App suites | 4,208 tests pass |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | All 3 steps pass; both release tests pass; 9.4 minutes |
| `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |

Clippy ran with both Rust wrapper variables unset and `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`.

The directly changed suites pass:

| Suite | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| motion `slot_round_ends` | 3 | 0 |
| motion `machining2d` | 68 | 0 |
| motion library | 515 | 10 |
| app `operations` | 121 | 6 |
| app `example_catalog` | 33 | 2 |
| app `clearance_in_stock` | 8 | 0 |
| app `golden_cl` | 33 | 0 |
| app `solid_law_goldens` | 7 | 0 |
| app `conformance` | 7 | 0 |

The clearance test still requires the first-traverse refusal and `RapidInStock { at: 1 }`.
The post remains held. The completed quick gate has no timeout failure in `adaptive_troch_parallel`.

Mutations repeated locally:

1. Disable the wall lap in `slots.rs`: all three slot pins fail. Climb and conventional leave 0.855 mm on the wall.
   Restore the source: all three pins pass.
2. Remove the row-end splits in `slot_lap.rs`: the off-tip-row test fails its crossing assertion.
   Restore the source: all three pins pass.

Both source restorations match byte for byte. The worktree has no source or golden changes.

Extra suites run:

I searched the test sources for readers of the changed fixture directories and their shared helpers.
In addition to the quick gate, I ran these 64 suites explicitly by name.
All 559 test executions pass.

- `camcraft-cl`: `headless_bin`.
- `camcraft-post`: `arc_planes`, `comment_escape`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `explain_remaining`, `explain_tormach`, `fanuc_post`, `grbl_dialect`, `heidenhain_block_form`, `heidenhain_cycles`, `inverted_post`, `post_engine`, `script_sinker_iso`, `script_sinker_side`, `work_offset_index`.
- `camcraft-app`: `adaptive_trochoid`, `altmill_machines`, `arc_entry`, `c_axis_live`, `c_axis_unwind`, `carvera_post`, `circular_stay_down`, `conformance`, `contour_start_point`, `control_comp`, `corner_relief`, `example_catalog`, `golden_cl`, `grblhal_post`, `lathe_post`, `lathe_post_css`, `lathe_post_g76`, `lathe_post_g76_schedule`, `lathe_post_inch`, `lathe_post_thread_dips`, `lathe_post_tormach`, `lathe_post_tormach_thread`, `microarc_test_part`, `plasma_post`, `plasma_post_refusals`, `pocket3d_trochoid`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `probe_op`, `program_comments`, `program_entry`, `program_units`, `rest_pocket`, `sinker_burn`, `sinker_orbit`, `sinker_side`, `sinker_undersize`, `sinker_wear`, `sinumerik_safe_retract`, `solid_law_goldens`, `stock_engine_agreement`, `stock_field_cost`, `thread_boss`, `thread_mill`, `tinyg_post`, `tormach_end_units`, `tormach_fourth_axis`, `tormach_machines`, `tormach_post`, `wear_comp`.

No importer source or STEP fixture changed. The extra kernel import suites do not apply.
No UI source changed, so the screenshot requirement does not apply.

Heavy lanes, author evidence checked in the updated PR body:

- The final-head heavy gate completes all 235 steps with exit 0.
- The motion lane completes 37 steps. The app lane completes 197 steps. The shared build is the remaining step.
- Six known-fail tests reproduce the expected failures for #1950 and #2849. The body names each test.
- No unexpected failure occurs. I did not repeat the full heavy gate; the local light lane passes both release tests.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Coordinator: this PR merges after the tag v0.25.0, by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"). The review that this merge relies on is the collaborator `pr-reviewer` marker on head 35020f6cc (clean). `cargo xtask merge-plan` puts it in wave 1: no refresh is needed. The PR merges cleanly with `main`. I merge it on head 35020f6cc. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.

Coordinator, for information: `main` is red after the merge of this PR (6cd4f3e01). The post-merge run fails in `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs`, test `a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size` (from #2920). The run on 5bc0b7129, the merge before this PR, is green. Each later commit inherits the red.

Issue #3278 tracks it, and a fix is in work. It decides whether the test expectation of #2920 or the code of this PR must change, and it tells you on this PR what changed. Please hold further merges to `main` until the post-merge run is green again, so that a second cause does not hide behind this one.

@mkinney For information: this PR merged after #2920, and its branch did not contain #2920. The wall lap of this PR changes the path of the DXF-outline slot in `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs`. The golden `slot_dxf_outline.cl` was not regenerated, so the post-merge gate on main went red (#3278). The generator is correct. PR #3285 regenerates the golden with the test's own `WRITE_GOLDEN` path. It also adds two asserts: each round end is cut on its 3 mm cutter-centre arc, and no cutting move leaves the outline at the tool radius. You do not have to do anything.
